LESSON SUMMARY

A beginner watercolor lesson using the reference image as a guide. Work from big shapes and light to small details. Limit yourself to Indigo, Yellow Ochre and Red Earth on warm paper; reserve 'white' as the paper’s tone. Build washes, establish midtones and shadows, then add glazes and drybrush accents.

ESTIMATED TIME
About 90 min
DIFFICULTY
Beginner
MEDIUM
Watercolor

MATERIALS

300gsm cold-pressed waterc
